changes: Fixed: QuickCheck could save your work in a different folder from the one it read next time, so classes and tests looked cleared. It now proves the folder works, always tells you which folder it uses, and warns if the program is opened from inside the zip.
Updating keeps your work: open a newer QuickCheck from any folder and your classes, tests, scores and key are already there.
QuickCheck tells you when a newer version is available.
Exam parts on one answer sheet: Part I multiple choice, Part II true or false, Part III matching type.
Progress across tests for each class and each learner.
Pro: interventions and reassessment, with before and after results and a printable report.
Import a class list from an Excel or CSV file, a DepEd class record, or cells copied from Excel.
Class records made in QuickCheck can be edited: learners, terms and score columns.
Formal DepEd-style test reports on screen, as PDF and as Excel.
